title: EPILOGUE // THE WEIRWOOD PACT
narrative: Not with swords, but with ancient blood and weirwood pacts, the war is brought to an end. Bran forges a treaty that mirrors the First Men of ten thousand years ago, yielding the lands beyond the Wall to the cold while the living rebuild the kingdoms of men in fragile, hard-won peace.
